description: The Euro-Mediterranean Submarine landSlide database (EMSS21) is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agencia Estatal Consejo Superior de Investigaciones Científicas. The Euro-Mediterranean Submarine landSlide database (EMSS21) displays information collected from both the literature and geophysical records. Data from the literature is collected from georeferenced map figures, from which the outline of the landslide deposit and the landslide scar have been digitized. Coverage: Agencia Estatal Consejo Superior de Investigaciones Científicas. The publisher named on the listing is Agencia Estatal Consejo Superior de Investigaciones Científicas. Its keywords include Trigger mechanism, Landslide scar, Geohazard, Submarine landslide, Landslide deposit. The listing shows 2026-06-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
